**Orglet 0.2.5** for Windows.

If you installed 0.2.4 with Setup, this one arrives by itself: Orglet downloads it in the background and uses it the next time you start the app. This is the first update that travels that way.

### Workers react

An orglet can now put an emoji on your message when it fits: a 🎉 when you share good news, a 👍 when you tell it how you like things. Most replies still get none. In a crew or group chat, orglets can react to each other's answers too, never to their own. Hover a reaction to see who left it.

This works for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent workers as well as API workers. A reaction is only a mark on the message; it never starts another run or sends a notification.

### Before you install

The installer is still not signed. Windows may say it protected your PC. If you downloaded Setup from this page, choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Orglet is open source under AGPL-3.0. This release ships for Windows only. Release checklist: [windows-release-gates.md](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/blob/main/docs/windows-release-gates.md).
